name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Boris, Mikhail, and Nadia go with Pin, 1386, and 1586, in some order.
Either 1286 goes with Zwischenzug or 1286 goes with Gambit.
1386 goes with at least one of Anatoly, Boris, or Pin.
If Boris goes with 1386, then Mikhail does not go with 1586.
Either 1486 goes with Nadia or Zwischenzug goes with Nadia.

Pin goes with Anatoly, so Boris can't go with Pin.

…but now the clue “Boris, Mikhail, and Nadia go with Pin, 1386, and 1586, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Anatoly does not go with Pin.
